title: Laws About Bodily Discharges

questions.question: What is the status of a man with a bodily discharge?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:2 (ESV): "When any man has a discharge from his body, his discharge is unclean."

questions.question: What happens to a bed where the one with the discharge lies?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:4 (ESV): "Every bed on which the one with the discharge lies shall be unclean."

questions.question: What must someone do if they touch the body of the one with the discharge?
options: Wash his clothes and bathe in water
questions.correctAnswer: Wash his clothes and bathe in water
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:7 (ESV): "And whoever touches the body of the one with the discharge shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water and be unclean until the evening."

questions.question: How long must the person count after the discharge has ceased before purification?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:13 (ESV): "When the one with a discharge is cleansed... then he shall count for himself seven days for his cleansing."

questions.question: What happens if a clay vessel is touched by the one with the discharge?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:12 (ESV): "And the earthenware vessel that the one with the discharge touches shall be broken."

questions.question: What offerings are brought on the eighth day?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:14 (ESV): "And on the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves or two pigeons..."

questions.question: If a man has an emission of semen, how long is he unclean?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:16 (ESV): "If a man has an emission of semen, he shall bathe his whole body in water and be unclean until the evening."

questions.question: What is the status of a woman during her menstrual impurity?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:19 (ESV): "When a woman has a discharge, and the discharge in her body is blood, she shall be in her menstrual impurity for seven days."

questions.question: What happens to anyone who touches her during this time?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:19 (ESV): "Whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening."

questions.question: If a man lies with her and her impurity comes on him, how long is he unclean?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:24 (ESV): "And if any man lies with her and her impurity comes upon him, he shall be unclean seven days."

questions.question: What if a woman has a discharge of blood for many days, not at the time of her impurity?
options: She is unclean as long as the discharge continues
questions.correctAnswer: She is unclean as long as the discharge continues
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:25 (ESV): "If a woman has a discharge of blood for many days... she shall be unclean."

questions.question: What is the penalty for defiling the tabernacle?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:31 (ESV): "Thus you shall keep the people of Israel separate from their uncleanness, lest they die in their uncleanness by defiling my tabernacle that is in their midst."

questions.question: What happens to a wooden vessel touched by the one with the discharge?
options: It shall be rinsed with water
questions.correctAnswer: It shall be rinsed with water
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:12 (ESV): "And every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water."

questions.question: What specific action renders a clean person unclean when encountering one with a discharge?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:8 (ESV): "And if the one with the discharge spits on him who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes..."

questions.question: What is the purpose of these regulations?
options: To keep Israel separate from uncleanness lest they defile God's dwelling
questions.correctAnswer: To keep Israel separate from uncleanness lest they defile God's dwelling
questions.explanation: Leviticus 15:31 (ESV): "Thus you shall keep the people of Israel separate from their uncleanness, lest they die... by defiling my tabernacle."

key_verse_text: Thus you shall keep the people of Israel separate from their uncleanness, lest they die in their uncleanness by defiling my tabernacle that is in their midst.
